dict.string: SportsMeal reads body weight, step count, active energy, and workouts from Apple Health to adjust your daily calorie budget. This data stays on your device and is never sent to SportsMeal servers.
SportsMeal writes your logged meal calories and exercise sessions back to Apple Health so your Health app stays current. You can turn any category off in Settings > Health > Data Access & Devices.

SportsMeal uses the camera to photograph meals so the AI can estimate calories and macros. Photos are sent to your chosen AI provider (Anthropic) using your own API key; SportsMeal does not store your photos on a server.

SportsMeal reads photos you choose to estimate calories and macros from meal images. Selected photos are sent to your chosen AI provider (Anthropic) using your own API key; SportsMeal does not keep a copy on a server.
